topic: Review: Every Mistral Vibe hook and plugin: the bindings in .vibe/hooks.toml, the repo-guards plugins and lib/hook-io.mjs, render-home-hooks.cjs, the session-lifecycle composers (turn-start, turn-end, session-start, compaction), the goal, hand-over, ask-surface, decision-capture, completion and skill-advisor adapters, and the Vibe session reader.

findingDetails.title: The spec-gate advise path never acknowledges delivery, so the notice repeats on every shell call
process_start is keyed by its bare name while every other map key is qualified
The session-cleanup hook imports another runtime's plugin outside the fail-open wrapper
The dispatch preflight passes the raw payload cwd to the rule engine

noveltyJustification: All four findings are new: none appears in the 29 dispositions in 023-vibe-review-remediation/implementation-summary.md. The closest prior findings (R4-P2-001--e3447f5b13ad, R4-P2-002--c3535226947a) were documentation fixes in guards-and-hooks.md, while R1-P1-001 is a code defect in the adapter's use of the core contract.
ruledOut: Journal segment ordering in the session reader: zero-padded journal names make the lexicographic sort correct
deep-loop-guard reading the wrong subagent field: tool_input.config_name is confirmed by guards-and-hooks.md:126 and VIB-HK-024
toCoreCall reading the wrong write path field: tool_input.file_path is confirmed by the wire-format fixture
spec-gate and spec-gate-classify keying different state files: both resolve to the same key
git-message-gate having no kill switch: documented as deliberate at lines 8-9

results.notes: Payload reads match the recorded wire format for tool_name, tool_input.command, tool_input.file_path, session_id, parent_session_id and transcript_path. The pre_tool advise reply field is not covered by the record.
The review target is a hook and plugin surface with no checklist document of its own.

findingDetails.title: The advise reply uses a field the recorded pre_tool format does not carry, on a strict binding
The startup-guard spawn budget equals the inner per-script budget, so the warnings are lost on a slow start
The goal part has no kill switch and the switch table does not mention it

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R2-P2-003 is adjacent to the prior R4-P2-003--8f1aef762f06 README fix but is the part that fix still omits, so it is a distinct open gap rather than a repeat.
ruledOut: session-cleanup not disposing the plugin at session start: dispose() runs the cleanup script, which is the session-end work
spec-gate-classify opening the gate for a subagent: classifyIntent returns before any state read when isChildSession is true
mcp-route-guard running on every pre_tool call: coreToolNameFor returns null for a non-MCP name
post-edit-quality command injection through an edited file's path: the router spawns without a shell

results.notes: The binding set matches the recorded 18 bindings. The reply format does not: the doc records one pre_tool reply and the code writes a second, unrecorded one.
No checklist document on a hook and plugin surface.

findingDetails.title: The hand-over part runs on every tool call with no size gate, so the journal is re-parsed each time
The session-start composer has no CLI-entry guard and no test, unlike the other three composers
The turn-start composer uses the raw payload cwd as the project root while the guard seam resolves it against the checkout

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R3-P2-001 is a different cost from the prior round's deferred R3-P2-003: a different file, a different mechanism, and the reader is named. R3-P2-002 and R3-P2-003 have no prior counterpart.
ruledOut: Journal segment ordering in the session reader: zero-padded names make the lexicographic sort correct
compaction-post-tool judging a non-post_tool payload: buildPostToolPart checks hook_event_name itself
turn-end requiring the completion part by an absolute path: createRequire accepts an absolute path and the path resolves correctly
A wrong relative root in any composer: each climbs the correct number of levels to the checkout

results.notes: The documented part order matches the code. The compaction binding's documented size gate holds for the compaction part only, not for the hand-over part beside it.
No checklist document on a hook and plugin surface.

findingDetails.title: A throwing nudge commit releases the claim and still delivers the nudge
The advisor's head receipt reads process.env instead of the env the adapter accepts
Two adapters accept an env seam and then ignore it for the enable check

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R4-P2-001 is in the same file as the prior R4-P2-003--f6d51a8e69ea but on a different mechanism (the claim path, not the withdraw path). R4-P2-002 and R4-P2-003 have no prior counterpart.
ruledOut: appendAdvisoryLog throwing and losing the pending advisory: the sentinel wraps its whole body and returns false
claimNudge throwing: it returns a no-op claim on any error
earlyWithdrawn growing without bound: each hook invocation is a fresh process and the entry is deleted in the same turn
goal-inject defaulting workspace to process.cwd(): both callers pass REPO_ROOT explicitly

results.notes: The hand-over claim invariant is enforced for the null outcome and not for a throw. The advisor's documented isolation switch is not honoured by the code that reads it.
No checklist document on a hook and plugin surface.

findingDetails.title: Three hooks gate on a post_tool field value the reference doc records as unobserved
dist-freshness.mjs re-implements the shared sessionDirFor instead of importing it
The port map records a clean hook verdict for two plugins whose tool registrations the port drops

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R5-P2-001 is the first finding about the post_tool payload field set; R5-P2-002 is the first about the duplicated sessionDirFor; R5-P2-003 is a different table row from the two prior documentation findings (R2-P2-001--d5b1ccf53ad4, R4-P2-001--e3447f5b13ad), which fixed other files.
ruledOut: A missing binding in .vibe/hooks.toml: the count is 18 and the event split matches the doc
An unclassified OpenCode plugin: all 21 rows are present
post-edit-quality running on a failed write: the tool_status gate at line 45 covers it and line 55 covers a file that does not exist
dist-freshness throwing on a missing python3: runChecker returns String(result.stdout ?? '') so a spawn error yields an empty banner

results.notes: The binding count matches the doc exactly: 18 [[hooks]] entries and the same event split. The post_tool field assumption and the two dropped tool registrations do not match.
No checklist document on a hook and plugin surface.
All 21 OpenCode plugins are classified and each not-needed verdict names a reason. Two hook rows omit the tool registrations the port drops.
VIB-HK-018 covers tool_status for a shell call only; no row covers a write_file or edit result.
